statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v : V) (c : ℂ)
  (v_pos : 0 < ‖v‖) (c_def : c = ⟪u,v⟫ / ↑‖v‖ ^ 2) : ‖c • v‖ ^ 2 = ‖⟪u,v⟫‖ ^ 2 / ‖v‖ ^ 2
name: LinearAlgebraGame.norm_sq_scaled_eq
content:
`norm_sq_scaled_eq` is a helper proof that if `0 < ‖v‖` and `c = ⟪u,v⟫ / ‖v‖^2`, then
`‖c • v‖^2 = ‖⟪u,v⟫‖^2 / ‖v‖^2`. The syntax is `norm_sq_scaled_eq u v c v_pos c_def`.
